arabic_html:
وَمَا مِن دَآبَّةٍۢ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ إِلَّا
عَلَى ٱللَّهِ رِزْقُهَا وَيَعْلَمُ مُسْتَقَرَّهَا وَمُسْتَوْدَعَهَا ۚ
كُلٌّۭ فِى كِتَٰبٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ ۞
translation: And there is no creature on earth but that upon Allah is its provision, and He knows its place of dwelling and place of storage. All is in a clear register.
explanation_html: Ibn Kathīr: every creature — small or great, land or sea — has its provision guaranteed by Allah. If He sustains the smallest thing that crawls, your share is not forgotten.
explanation_vo: Ibn Kathir: every creature — small or great, land or sea — has its provision guaranteed by Allah. If He sustains the smallest thing that crawls, your share is not forgotten.
